note: CS-52's labelled set for listing.facts, labelled on 2026-09-30 from labelling-guide.md before any model saw the new items. Real listings are canonical snapshots of the lane database (a copy of main's, whose ids they keep), with sales staff names, gallery names, addresses and registration codes replaced; the crawler had already removed phone numbers. Hand-made items (source injection and hand-made) are real listings with one added or changed line, named in basedOn.
